title: #335 Friends' Opinions
prompt: Some people think that the family has the most important influence on young adults. Other people think that friends have the most important influence on young adults. What is your opinion?

promptSegments.text: Some people think that the family has the most important influence on young adults.
Other people think that friends have the most important influence on young adults.

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The family unit is a very important source of help for young adults.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The family unit is a very important source of help for young adults.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Another reason is that family provides a strong support system for young adults.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Another reason is that family provides a strong support system for young adults.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that friends, not family, are the most important influence on young adults.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that friends, not family, are the most important influence on young adults.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay uses simple examples (talking in groups, studying for tests) to show the positive impact of friendships.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay uses simple examples (talking in groups, studying for tests) to show the positive impact of friendships.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The family unit establishes a strong foundation by teaching basic values and life skills, providing essential guidance for young adults' development.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The family unit establishes a strong foundation by teaching basic values and life skills, providing essential guidance for young adults' development.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, family bonds offer a stable emotional support system, ensuring young adults feel secure and cared for when facing difficulties.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, family bonds offer a stable emotional support system, ensuring young adults feel secure and cared for when facing difficulties.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that friends, rather than family, have the most significant influence on young adults.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that friends, rather than family, have the most significant influence on young adults.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The body paragraphs focus on how friends help young adults develop independence and build a unique support system.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The body paragraphs focus on how friends help young adults develop independence and build a unique support system.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?

faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.

modelPlan.focus: Discuss the influence of family and friends on young adults, arguing that family has a more significant role.
outline: family's influence on moral values and life lessons
friends' role in social development and peer pressure
keyArguments: Family provides a stable support system and moral guidance which is crucial for young adults.
While friends play a role in social development, their influence can sometimes be negative and less consistent than that of family.
